char.label: Character
char.description: The main character column in the reference list, used to align individual characters.

pronunciation.label: Reading
pronunciation.description: The main reading or transcription column used to align entries in the reference list.

note.label: Notes
note.description: An optional column for preserving manually entered notes.

jyutping.label: Jyutping
jyutping.description: The required source column for conversion; it must contain valid Jyutping syllables.

char.label: Character
char.description: An optional head-character column used for result previews and manual checking.

char.label: Character
char.description: The character column used for row-by-row validation and locating individual entries.

ipa.label: Phonetic Transcription
ipa.description: The main transcription column used to separate initials, finals, and tones and to detect errors.

note.label: Notes
note.description: An optional column for preserving manually entered annotations.

name.label: Location Name
name.description: The location name associated with each Voronoi point, used in previews, duplicate-name checks, and the excluded-point list.

lng.label: Longitude
lng.description: The longitude column; together with latitude, it must form a valid coordinate.

lat.label: Latitude
lat.description: The latitude column; together with longitude, it must form a valid coordinate.

mapPartition.label: Atlas Region
mapPartition.description: The region column used for atlas-based Voronoi calculations. Hierarchical values in A-B-C format are supported.

yindianPartition.label: MCPDict Region
yindianPartition.description: The region column used for MCPDict-based Voronoi calculations. Hierarchical values in A-B-C format are supported.
